wpPortfolio.title: Digital Warranty & Receipt Vault
wpPortfolio.content: emQube developed a mobile application that allows users to store, categorize, and retrieve digital receipts and appliance warranties in a centralized, secure vault.

seo.opengraphDescription: emQube developed a mobile application that allows users to store, categorize, and retrieve digital receipts and appliance warranties in a centralized, secure vault.
seo.title: Digital Warranty & Receipt Vault - emQube

softwarePortfolioLayout.aboutApplication:
Available for iOS and Android, this mobile app enables users to capture images of physical bills and record warranty details directly. The application also supports the conversion of PDF electronic bills into searchable records, which are backed up to Google Drive for secure, cross-device retrieval.


Users can categorize their bills by appliance type, simplifying the retrieval process for warranty claims. The app provides a convenient, paperless solution for consumers to manage their purchase history and warranty protection across multiple retail brands.
softwarePortfolioLayout.clientName: A reputable electronics retail chain with stores across the UAE.
